---
title: "Experience"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml

with open('data/experience.yaml', 'r') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

for job in data['experience']:
    print(f"## {job['title']}\n")
    print(f"**{job['organization']}** | {job['location']} | {job['period']}\n")
    
    if job.get('note'):
        print(f"*{job['note']}*\n")
    
    if job.get('bullets'):
        for bullet in job['bullets']:
            print(f"- {bullet}")
        print()
    
    if job.get('projects'):
        for proj in job['projects']:
            link = f" — [Campaign site]({proj['url']})" if proj.get('url') else ""
            print(f"### {proj['name']}{link}\n")
            if proj.get('description'):
                print(f"*{proj['description'].strip()}*\n")
            for bullet in proj['bullets']:
                print(f"- {bullet}")
            print()
    
    print("---\n")
```
